race.comment: Race decimated by scratchings, which leaves COL BURN (1) on top. He is worth another chance after racing wide when last at Sunshine Coast, especially off his strong heavy-track Class 2 win the start prior. Can bounce back to winning form. PORSHA CRYSTAL (9) is back from a freshening and trialled solidly since a messy Sunshine Coast run. Capable of improvement here. TRIBBIANI (3) was ordinary last start but has featured in 4/4 on the going, including two wins. Can feature. I'M LUCKY TWO (13) narrow Dalby second had merit with interference in running. Wet form and barrier 1 help. Can contest the finish.
